name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 34 – Am 14
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 34a. Calls for the transparency register to become genuinely mandatory, requiring all interest representatives engaging in interest representation activities vis-à-vis the EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies to register, rather than limiting mandatory registration to specific activities subject to conditionality;
